title: Contemporary Torremolinos apartments with sea views  Torremolinos apartments
summary: Designed with a perfect balance of elegance and functionality, these contemporary Torremolinos apartments with sea views embrace the essence of coastal luxury and tranquillity.
description:
Designed with a perfect balance of elegance and functionality, these contemporary Torremolinos apartments with sea views embrace the essence of coastal luxury and tranquillity.

This unique residential complex in Torremolinos, consisting of just eight thoughtfully designed homes, all with private swimming pools, blends contemporary craftsmanship and coastal living. The 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartments built using the finest quality materials, feature chic styling, effectively blurring  interior and exterior spaces with the use of expansive walls of glass.

The apartments offer a seamless integration of the open-plan kitchen and elegant living room with the large outdoor terrace boasting stunning sea views. The two bedrooms provide the ultimate relaxing retreat, with large glass doors flooding the rooms with natural light and opening out to the beautiful outdoor spaces. The modern bathrooms exude sophistication, creating the perfect space to refresh the mind, body and senses.

The expansive outdoor area is the ideal peaceful spot to enjoy your morning coffee as you watch the sun rising over the horizon, a tranquil space to unwind, take a dip in your own private swimming pool, or a place to entertain family and friends.

Perched on a hillside in Torremolinos to maximize the views and natural sunlight, this residential complex is a contemporary expression of functional and sustainable design, incorporating enhanced soundproofing materials and insulation techniques into the building design to improve energy efficiency and reduce energy costs. Parking spaces and storerooms are available with the homes, which are in a prime location, just a seven minute walk to the beach.

Often referred to as the birthplace of Spain’s tourism industry, Torremolinos continues to attract visitors from around the world, drawn to its emblematic beach bars, bustling town centre, more than 300 days of sunshine each year, and its superb location. Málaga city centre, renowned for its culture and heritage, can be reached in under fifteen minutes by car, and there is an excellent train service connecting the coastal towns of Málaga, Torremolinos, Benalmadena and Fuengirola and also Malaga Airport. The apartments also offer easy access to Marbella and Puerto Banus, where you can choose from world-class dining options, shops and services.

Live the dream lifestyle in these contemporary apartments, where every day will feel like a holiday!
